# CampusConnect BU: Copilot instructions

Project: university networking and academic collaboration platform for Babcock University
students. Stack: React (Vite) + JavaScript + CSS frontend, Python Flask REST API, MySQL.

Rules:
- Inspect existing files before editing. Do not rewrite the whole app.
- Preserve working functionality. Reuse existing components and styles.
- No new dependencies unless I approve them.
- Write clean, reusable code with validation and error handling.
- Keep layouts responsive and accessible (semantic HTML, labels, focus states).
- Use fictional sample data only.
- Explain important changes in simple terms and give me manual test steps.
- Add automated tests where appropriate.
- Do not implement beyond the task I give you.
